jobs.description:
Job Title: Freelance Caregiver – Home Healthcare \| Pan India

Company: Klickon Digital Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.

Location: BANGALURU

Job Type: Part\-time \| Freelance \| Flexible Hours

Salary: Per visit / assignment, as agreed

Experience: Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.

About Klickon Digital Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.

Klickon is building a healthcare platform that connects patients and families with reliable caregivers for home\-based care. We are looking for compassionate, responsible, and dedicated caregivers to support patients in their homes across India.

Key Responsibilities

\- Provide personal care and daily living assistance to patients at home.

\- Assist elderly, bedridden, and mobility\-restricted patients.

\- Help patients with bathing, grooming, dressing, and hygiene.

\- Assist with walking, repositioning, and safe transfers.

\- Support feeding and daily routines as required.

\- Monitor and report changes in the patient's condition to the family or supervising healthcare professional.

\- Provide companionship and emotional support.

\- Maintain cleanliness and follow hygiene and infection prevention practices.

\- Assist with post\-hospitalization recovery and routine patient care within the assigned role.

\- Maintain patient dignity, safety, and confidentiality.

Eligibility Criteria

\- Qualification: Caregiver training or a relevant healthcare certificate preferred; candidates with practical caregiving experience may also apply.

\- Previous experience in elderly care, patient care, or home healthcare is an advantage.

\- Good communication skills and a caring attitude.

\- Willingness to provide services in the candidate's own city or service area.

\- Responsible, punctual, and patient\-focused.

\- Freshers may apply, subject to training and assignment requirements.

Work Arrangement

\- Freelance engagement; not a full\-time salaried position.

\- Part\-time work with flexible availability.

\- Home assignments based on patient requirements and location.

\- Payment per visit, shift, or assignment, as mutually agreed.

\- Opportunities across India, subject to service availability in each city.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through Indeed with their updated CV or profile

OR Whatsapp at 9204500892

Please mention your current city, caregiving experience, preferred service area, availability, and expected fee per visit or shift.

Candidate identity and experience will be verified before onboarding.

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹63,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff Nurse
jobs.description:
Job Summary


We are seeking a qualified and dedicated Staff Nurse with experience in Critical Care Units (CCU, ICU) and the Emergency Room (ER). The ideal candidate will provide high\-quality patient care, respond effectively to emergencies, monitor critically ill patients, and collaborate with the multidisciplinary healthcare team to ensure the best clinical outcomes.


Key Responsibilities


* Assess, monitor, and document patients' clinical conditions accurately.
* Provide comprehensive nursing care to critically ill and emergency patients.
* Operate and monitor critical care equipment, including cardiac monitors, ventilators, infusion pumps, and defibrillators.
* Administer medications, IV fluids, blood products, and treatments as prescribed.
* Recognize and respond promptly to medical emergencies and changes in patient condition.
* Assist physicians during emergency procedures, intubation, central line insertion, and resuscitation.
* Perform CPR and participate in code blue and emergency response teams.
* Maintain accurate nursing records and documentation.
* Ensure strict infection prevention and patient safety practices.
* Educate patients and their families regarding treatment plans and post\-care instructions.
* Coordinate with doctors and allied healthcare professionals to deliver quality patient care.
* Maintain cleanliness, availability, and functionality of emergency and critical care equipment.

Qualifications


* B.Sc. Nursing or GNM from a recognized institution.
* Valid Nursing Council registration.
* BLS certification required; ACLS certification preferred.
* Minimum 1–6 years of experience in CCU, ICU, or ER (freshers with relevant critical care training may also be considered).

Required Skills


* Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills.
* Knowledge of emergency and critical care protocols.
* Ability to work under pressure and make timely decisions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Team\-oriented with a compassionate approach to patient care.
* Proficiency in electronic medical records (EMR) is an advantage.

Preferred Experience


* Experience in handling ventilated patients and cardiac emergencies.
* Familiarity with ECG interpretation, emergency medications, and critical care procedures.
* Experience in trauma and emergency management is an added advantage.

Work Schedule


* Rotational shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays, as per hospital requirements.

Salary


Competitive salary and benefits, based on qualifications and experience.


Benefits:


* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.


Job Summary: The Entry Engineer is responsible for assisting in the design and development of processes for manufacturing chemicals and related products. This role involves working under the guidance of experienced engineers, conducting research, analyzing data, and contributing to the optimization of production processes. Responsibilities: • Research and Development • Conduct experiments and trials to develop new chemical processes or products • Analyze data and interpret results to make recommendations for improvement • Collaborate with other engineers and scientists to design and implement new processes • Process Design and Optimization • Design and optimize chemical processes and equipment for maximum efficiency and productivity • Troubleshoot and resolve any issues with current processes • Continuously improve processes through data analysis and implementation of new technologies • Quality Control • Implement quality control measures to ensure products meet safety and regulatory standards • Monitor and analyze production processes to identify any potential quality issues • Develop and implement solutions to improve product quality and consistency • Project Management • Plan and manage projects related to new product development, process optimization, and quality control • Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget • Communicate project updates and progress to stakeholders and upper management • Safety and Environmental Compliance • Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and protocols in the Engineering industry • Develop and implement safety procedures for handling and disposal of hazardous materials • Stay updated on environmental regulations and make recommendations for sustainable practices High Impact Behaviors: • Continuous Professional Development: Professionals should be committed to lifelong learning, seeking out opportunities for self\-improvement, and staying abreast of industry trends and best practices. • Collaboration and Teamwork: Effective professionals understand the value of collaboration. They work well with others, contribute to team goals, and understand that diverse perspectives can lead to better solutions. • Results\-Driven Performance: High\-performing professionals focus on delivering results. They set high standards for their own performance and are committed to achieving objectives efficiently and effectively. Qualifications: • A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field or equivalent work experience that provides exposure to fundamental theories, principles, and concepts. • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. • Basic knowledge of chemical process engineering and safety regulations. • Proficiency in data analysis and simulation software. • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

**We're Hiring! \| Graphic Designer** 

**Company:** Xteriya  
**Job Title:** Graphic Designer  
**Experience:** 0–1 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)  
**Location:** Chennai

**Job Overview**

Are you someone who turns creative ideas into eye\-catching designs? Do you have an eye for colours, layouts, typography, and visual storytelling?

Xteriya is looking for a creative and detail\-oriented **Graphic Designer** who can transform concepts into engaging visual content. We are looking for someone who enjoys experimenting with design trends, creating impactful graphics, and bringing fresh ideas to the table.

Whether you're a fresher with a strong creative portfolio or an experienced designer, this is an opportunity to showcase your talent and grow with us!

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Design attractive and professional posters, banners, and promotional creatives for digital platforms.
* Create engaging social media graphics for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other platforms.
* Develop recruitment posters, corporate creatives, marketing materials, and branding designs.
* Work on layouts, typography, colour combinations, and visual elements to create impactful designs.
* Convert creative concepts and business requirements into visually appealing designs.
* Maintain brand consistency across all designs and marketing materials.
* Collaborate with the HR and marketing teams to understand design requirements.
* Stay updated with the latest graphic design trends, tools, and creative techniques.
* Make necessary design modifications and deliver creatives within deadlines.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 0–1 years of experience in Graphic Designing. Freshers with good design skills are welcome.
* Proficiency in **Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator**, or similar design tools.
* Good understanding of colour theory, typography, layouts, and visual composition.
* Ability to create professional posters, social media creatives, and marketing designs.
* Creative thinking with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to understand design briefs and deliver quality outputs.
* A creative portfolio or previous design samples is required.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of branding and social media design trends.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing creatives.
* Ability to work on multiple design projects simultaneously.
* Knowledge of AI\-powered design tools is an added advantage.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on diverse creative projects.
* Freedom to experiment with new design ideas.
* Professional learning and skill\-development opportunities.
* A collaborative and creative working environment.
* Opportunity to build a strong design portfolio.
